focus_areas: Edge integrity between flower and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the white petals and the dark background. Real macro shots often have slight chromatic aberration or softness; AI generations often have unnaturally perfect, hard edges. Also, inspect the yellow center for repetitive patterns which might indicate texture tiling. Verify if the 'melted' foliage in the lower left has valid bounding boxes and topological continuity.
image_description: A close-up photograph of a white daisy with a yellow center, positioned in the upper right quadrant against a dark, blurred green background. A second partial daisy head is visible at the bottom center. Green leaves and a slender stem are visible in the lower foreground.
